title: [Crash] System.NotSupportedException: Incompatible connection file format (file format version 2,9).
author: robertpopa22
body_snippet:
## Crash Report

### Exception
**Type:** `System.NotSupportedException`
**Message:** Incompatible connection file format (file format version 2,9).

### Stack Trace
```
   at void mRemoteNG.Config.Serializers.ConnectionSerializers.Xml.XmlConnectionsDeserializer.ValidateConnectionFileVersion() in D:/a/mRemoteNG/mRemoteNG/mRemoteNG/Config/Serializers/ConnectionSerializers/Xml/XmlConnectionsDeserializer.cs:line 185
   at ConnectionTreeModel mRemoteNG.Config.Serializers.ConnectionSerializer...

comments.author: jblion
comments.snippet: Workaround: I modified the version manually.

comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
Thank you for adding the workaround: "the file loads once the version is edited" is what showed this was only a version limit, not a real format difference.

The file was last saved by an upstream mRemoteNG build, which writes `ConfVersion="2.9"` since October. This fork accepted 2.8 at most and refused the file. Nightly `1.84.0+f7ff789c90` (https://github.com/robertpopa22/mRemoteNG/releases/tag/nightly) accepts 2.9.

What 2.9 adds over 2.8 is three settings per connection: TerminalBackend, Colo...

notes: fix shipped 139ed48a6 in nightly 1.84.0+f7ff789c90; awaiting reporter confirm
